30787 -> 0.721, then 38508 -> 0.518 (DOWN), then 42914 -> 0.56 (stays low)

HYPOTHESIS 1: v99 and alpha are NOT correlated.

HYPOTHESIS 3: Some observable property of the rank-99 distribution (e.g., clustering, dominance) predicts

HELD BELIEF c91dba00 (universal alpha=1.54):
- Claims: one-input law, alpha is universal constant
- Falsifier criterion: frozen chi2>26 AND fitted chi2<26 on same date

Evidence on record:
2025-01-15: frozen=35.31 (FAIL), fitted alpha=0.518 chi2=11.86 (PASS)
2025-06-01: frozen=32.81 (FAIL), fitted alpha~0.5-0.6 chi2<11 (PASS)

VERDICT: Both dates satisfy the falsifier criterion.
The belief must be retracted.

What replaces it:
